fuzzy-foundry.settings.deepFile.name: Deep File Search
fuzzy-foundry.settings.deepFile.hint: Search for files inside all folders when using the File Picker.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.deepFilePlayers.h: Allow players to use the deep file search. WARNING: players will be able to find ANY indexed file.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.deepFileCharLimit: The minimum number of characters required to trigger the deep file search.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.deepFileExclude.h: Comma separated keywords. Files whose path contains any of them are hidden from the results.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.indexWorlds.name: Deep File Search: Index Worlds Folder
fuzzy-foundry.settings.indexWorlds.hint: Include the worlds folder in the file index. Requires rebuilding the file index.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.indexSystems.name: Deep File Search: Index Systems Folder
fuzzy-foundry.settings.indexSystems.hint: Include the systems folder in the file index. Requires rebuilding the file index.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.indexModules.name: Deep File Search: Index Modules Folder
fuzzy-foundry.settings.indexModules.hint: Include the modules folder in the file index. Requires rebuilding the file index.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.useS3.name: Deep File Search: Index S3 Bucket
fuzzy-foundry.settings.useS3.hint: Include an S3 bucket in the file index. Requires rebuilding the file index.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.useS3name.name: Deep File Search: S3 Bucket Name
fuzzy-foundry.settings.useS3name.hint: The name of the S3 bucket to index. Requires rebuilding the file index.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.chatSearch.name: Chat Search
fuzzy-foundry.settings.chatSearch.hint: Show a search box above the chat log that searches every chat message.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.props.name: Property Search Filters
fuzzy-foundry.settings.props.hint: Comma separated actor properties, relative to the system data (for example details.cr). Prefix a search with ! for an exact match.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.excavateFilters.h: Comma separated folder names. When set, Excavate only picks images whose path contains one of them.
When excavating actors, set the prototype token to a wildcard path that matches similar images and enable Randomize Wildcard Images.
fuzzy-foundry.settings.indexVersion.name: File Index Version
fuzzy-foundry.index.building: Dig Down | Building the file index...
fuzzy-foundry.index.done: Dig Down | File index ready: {files} files in {folders} folders
fuzzy-foundry.index.saveFailed: Dig Down | The file index could not be saved to the server, other users will not receive it.
fuzzy-foundry.index.disabled: Dig Down | Deep File Search is disabled.
fuzzy-foundry.excavate.noIndex: Dig Down | The file index is not ready, Excavate needs Deep File Search.
fuzzy-foundry.chat.truncated: Showing the latest {shown} of {total} matching messages.
